mechanism: Mefloquine is a CNS depressant and can potentiate the sedative effects of clonazepam; mefloquine also has neuropsychiatric adverse effects that may be compounded by benzodiazepine use.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses of clonazepam with close monitoring for excessive sedation, cognitive impairment, and neuropsychiatric effects.
